contradictions.description: F1 says power was lost at 02:14 but F11 shows the alarm at 02:41
F3 says service restored at 06:34 (outage 4h20m per F4) but F16 says utility feed restored and service confirmed normal at 08:05
F5 says 312 customers affected but F22 says 213
F6 says Priya Raman approved the failover but F13 says Daniel Okafor
F2 says the UPS carried the load for 15 minutes but F12 says 9 minutes
F19 says roughly 11 hours of runtime but F25 says 20 percent, about 3 hours
F7 says a storm triggered the fault but F28 records clear skies and F29 attributes it to a transformer failure
F22 says 41 premium customers but F31 says 38
F19 says about 11 hours of fuel but F15 says Generator B shut down at 04:10, about 78 minutes after coming online (assumes the shutdown was fuel-related, which the facts do not say)
